# Codex hook script version registry
#
# Append-only sha256 registry for files in this directory.
# Format: <sha256>  <filename>
#
# Update protocol: when modifying any *.sh file in this directory, add
# a NEW line with the updated hash IN THE SAME COMMIT — do not edit or
# remove existing lines. Historical hashes let `sage update` distinguish
# "old framework version, replace with current" from "unknown shadow
# file, refuse overwrite".
#
# See: .sage/docs/decision-codex-hook-activation.md (ADR-1).
